chinese: 好的，和你交谈真是太好了，但我得走了。

english: We'll catch up soon, maybe over coffee.
chinese: 我们很快就会见面，或许在咖啡馆里。

english: I cannot stand that woman or her obnoxious daughter.
chinese: 我不能忍受那个女人或者她的无理取闹的女儿。

english: So now you have a couple of phrases that you can use to flatter someone, be it your friend
chinese: 所以现在你有两句你可以用来夸奖别人的短语，比如你的朋友。

english: or somebody that you know or anyone.
chinese: 或者你认识的人，或者任何人。

english: And well, they are very, very useful and if you use them correctly, of course.
chinese: 而且，它们非常有用。如果你正确使用它们，当然。
正确。以下是“right”在中文中的翻译：

english: And these phrases sound really honest and really natural, very native like.
chinese: 这些短语听起来真的很诚实和自然，非常地道。

english: So if you have any other questions or comments or if you want to share some other phrases
chinese: 所以如果有其他问题或评论，或者如果你想分享一些其他的短语，请告诉我。

english: that you use to flatter people, come to our website at EnglishPod.com and leave them
chinese: 这句话的意思是：“你使用来夸奖人的技巧，访问我们的网站www.englishpod.com并留下他们。”

chinese: 所以马科和我得出发了，但我们期待着在网站上见到你。

chinese: 谢谢你的倾听，下一次见。
